branding.title: Branding
branding.tip: Name, description and logo appear in the tab title, the header, the installed app (PWA) and search engines. Only the site itself is indexed, never the songs.
branding.name: Site name

discord.tip: Create an Application at discord.com/developers/applications: its name is what appears after “Listening to”. Users just run one command (a script served by this server, no exe to download).
discord.agentUrlHint: Users run the agent with the script at /agent.ps1 (Windows) or /agent.sh (macOS / Linux). Set this only to also offer exe builds (e.g. GitHub Releases).

logs.title: System logs
logs.tip: The server's latest 3,000 log lines, refreshed every 3 seconds. Passwords and tokens are masked.
